notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
description:
Activate Heliod by paying {1}{W}, giving Casey lifelink.
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Casey.
Casey triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent and causing you to gain 1 life due to its lifelink.
Repeat from step 3.
